cohort: 140 singleton, term neonates (113 controls and 27 with birth asphyxia)
finding: Copeptin levels in umbilical cord blood were significantly higher in neonates with birth asphyxia and correlated with markers of hypoxia, suggesting its potential as a biomarker for birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: Copeptin levels were elevated in neonates born via vacuum extraction, whereas erythropoietin levels showed a slight increase after emergency cesarean section.
